answer: Because each dune escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the pearl ledger records every share and the saffron audit publishes the split. A bond must be split across 6 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 181 aliases means 181 times 6 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
